summary: Service account token audience normalization prevents scheduled batch workers from authenticating in private VPC
description:
Issue summary:
Customer's scheduled batch workers (service-account-based) started failing auth to Redwood private VPC endpoints after a configuration change to the identity proxy layer. Failures began around 2026-03-13 18:12 UTC.

Impact:
- All scheduled inference batch jobs for Orchid Health in us-west failing to authenticate; retries exhausted and jobs listed as "Failed" in UI.
- Customer reports degraded downstream processing for nightly summarization pipeline (approx. 1200 jobs/day).
- Symptoms are 401/403 from token-exchange endpoint with 'audience_mismatch' diagnostics.

Environment:
- Private deployment (customer-managed VPC) using Redwood Private v1.9.2.
- identity-proxy v2.4.1 (deployed 2026-03-12) sits in front of token-exchange service.
- Scheduled workers use projected service account JWTs with aud claim: 'urn:redwood:service:orchid-batch' (previously accepted).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Trigger a scheduled batch job using the customer's service-account projection flow in their private VPC.
2) Observe client calls to /v1/auth/token-exchange fail.
3) Inspect token-exchange logs for audit/validation error.

Expected behavior:
- Projected service account JWT aud claim is validated against configured accepted audiences and exchange succeeds, returning a short-lived platform token.

Actual behavior:
- The identity-proxy normalizes audience values by lowercasing and URL-decoding, turning 'urn:redwood:service:orchid-batch' into 'urn:redwood:service:orchid-batch' (same) for this example, but for some customers the aud was namespaced URL style and normalization removed tenant prefixes (e.g., 'https://orchid.prod.svc/redwood' -> 'orchid.prod.svc/redwood'), causing strict audience comparison to fail. Token-exchange rejects with audience_mismatch.

Relevant logs (redacted):
- identity-proxy: 2026-03-13T18:11:53Z WARN audience_normalizer: "normalized aud=orchid.prod.svc/redwood from raw=https%3A%2F%2Forchid.prod.svc%2Fredwood"
- token-exchange: 2026-03-13T18:12:01Z ERROR auth_validator: "aud check failed: expected one of [urn:redwood:service:orchid-batch], got orchard.prod.svc/redwood; request_id=za1bq"

Notes:
- Customer had not changed service account projection config. The only recent change in their control plane was a rolling deploy of identity-proxy v2.4.1 on 2026-03-12 (cherry-pick of normalization logic intended for public tenants).
- Orchids' service-account aud format mixes URL and URN styles across older jobs and new jobs; previously our token-exchange accepted several loose forms. The deploy tightened comparison semantics and added normalization which is now removing characters that are part of tenant scoping.

Attachments:
- token-exchange debug traces (attached), identity-proxy deploy manifest (attached), sample failing JWT (redacted), customer job IDs: [batch-20260313-0902, batch-20260313-1145].
investigation_notes: 03-13 18:30 UTC - Confirmed spike of 401/403s from customer's worker pool correlated with identity-proxy rollout timeline.
03-13 19:05 UTC - Reproduced locally by generating a projected JWT with URL-style aud and routing through identity-proxy v2.4.1; observed normalization behavior noted in logs.
03-13 20:10 UTC - Token-exchange comparison is strict equality against configured accepted_audiences list; normalization happens earlier in proxy and is not communicated to token-exchange.
03-13 21:40 UTC - Hypothesis: normalization removed tenant namespace separators (percent-decoding + path-trim) causing aud mismatch for customers using URL aud format.
03-14 09:12 UTC - Reproduced failure in a staging private deployment when proxy normalization flag enabled; adding a compatibility path in token-exchange toggles acceptance.
comments: Customer (Orchid Support) - 2026-03-13 18:45 UTC: 'We started seeing thousands of failed jobs. Nothing changed on our side. Please advise.'
Support (Marco Chen) - 2026-03-13 19:02 UTC: 'Acknowledged — investigating. Can you confirm any recent deploy windows? We've scheduled an internal review.'
Eng (Priya Desai) - 2026-03-13 20:20 UTC: 'Found normalization logic in identity-proxy. Reproducing with unit test. Will propose a quick config toggle to disable URL-decoding for aud normalization.'
SRE (Liam O'Connor) - 2026-03-14 08:55 UTC: 'Prepared hotfix branch for identity-proxy to preserve original aud when it matches configured accepted audiences; prepping canary in staging.'
Customer (Orchid Support) - 2026-03-14 10:03 UTC: 'Thanks — any ETA on a fix? Our nightly run is at 02:00 local and we need reliability for tomorrow.'
resolution_notes: 03-14 13:20 UTC - Rolled back identity-proxy normalization commit in customer us-west private cluster (rollback of v2.4.1 to v2.4.0).
03-14 13:40 UTC - Token-exchange accepted previously failing requests; customer confirmed jobs started succeeding again (sample batch job IDs retried successfully).

03-14 15:00 UTC - Hotfix PR created to introduce a compatibility mode: when 'preserve_aud_exact=true' is set in proxy config, normalization is skipped and raw aud passed through. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/4123
Follow-up: Add regression test covering URL and URN aud forms, update release notes, and schedule backport to 2.4.X maintenance branch.
postmortem_action_items: Create automated test matrix for aud normalization cases (URNs, URLs, percent-encoded values).
Add telemetry to token-exchange to surface normalized_vs_raw_aud when validation fails (capture sample hashed value for privacy).
Document recommended aud formats for private deployments and include migration steps for customers using URL-style audiences.
Backport hotfix to 2.4.2 and coordinate with Ops to schedule patch window for remaining private clusters.
